first.rationale: Activation and onboarding completion are both down 4-6% QoQ. The durable memory shows that signup simplification (memory_31) improved SMB activation with durable lift, and shortening onboarding (memory_86) improved completion rates and time-to-value. Both directly address the current performance declines. Verification of these two memories will confirm the magnitude of prior lift and whether conditions remain similar. Promotional pricing would compete on the margin against the new entrant but doesn't address the internal activation degradation. Referral incentives and enterprise sales assist target different segments and do not address the QoQ declines in core product activation. Simplify_onboarding is the highest-probability lever for recovering the lost activation and completion metrics while building sustainable long-term qualified revenue rather than discounting into a price war.
